parameters.jsCode:
const base = $input.first().json;
const placeLines = (base.places || []).map(p =>
  '- ' + p.name + (p.category ? ' (' + p.category + ')' : '') + ' @ ' + p.lat + ',' + p.lon
).join('\n') || '(no candidates found)';
const weatherText = base.weather ? JSON.stringify(base.weather) : (base.weather_message || 'unavailable');
const stops = (base.user_stops || []).map(s => s.name).join(', ') || 'none';
const prompt = [
  'You are TravelMate, an expert trip planner. Create a realistic day-by-day itinerary.',
  '',
  'Trip:',
  '- From: ' + base.origin,
  '- Destination: ' + base.destination,
  '- Dates: ' + base.start_date + ' to ' + base.end_date + ' (' + base.duration_days + ' days)',
  '- Travellers: ' + base.traveller_count,
  '- Total budget: ' + base.budget + ' ' + base.currency,
  '- Interests: ' + (base.preferences || 'general sightseeing'),
  '- Transport preference: ' + base.transport_preference,
  '- Accommodation preference: ' + base.accommodation_preference,
  '- Must include these user stops: ' + stops,
  '',
  'Candidate places (prefer these; use exact names and coordinates):',
  placeLines,
  '',
  'Weather forecast:',
  weatherText,
  '',
  'Rules:',
  '- Return ONLY valid JSON. No markdown, no code fences, no commentary.',
  '- Exactly ' + base.duration_days + ' day objects with day_number 1..' + base.duration_days + '.',
  '- 3 to 5 activities per day. Prefer real places from the candidate list. Never invent place names, prices, or weather.',
  '- itinerary item fields: day_number, activity_name, description, location, start_time "HH:MM", end_time "HH:MM", estimated_cost (decimal string, no currency symbol), latitude, longitude, sort_order.',
  '- Use the candidate coordinates for matching places; otherwise null.',
  '- days: one entry per day with day_number, title, summary, stop_name.',
  '- expenses: realistic allocation with categories only from transport, accommodation, food, activities, local_transport, misc. Fields: category, description, amount (decimal string).',
  '- stops: 2 to 6 areas or neighbourhoods. Fields: name, latitude, longitude (from candidates when possible).',
  '- hero_quote (max 200 chars) and hero_quote_author (max 80 chars).',
  '',
  'Return this JSON shape:',
  '{"itinerary":[],"days":[],"expenses":[],"stops":[],"hero_quote":"","hero_quote_author":""}'
].join('\n');
return [{ json: Object.assign({}, base, { prompt }) }];

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ contents: [{ parts: [{ text: $json.prompt }] }], generationConfig: { temperature: 0.7, responseMimeType: 'application/json' } }) }}
